title: JoinRequest
description: The body of POST /api/live/join (ADR 0007 section 2, ADR 0002 section 8), sent with no credential: exactly the join code and a nickname. The rider's FTP and maximum heart rate stay on the phone and have no field here.

session.description: The join code as XXXX-XXXX; the page normalises what was typed (case, spaces, hyphens) before sending. It only names the session.

nickname.description: The rider's nickname, 1 to 24 characters with control characters removed by the server; always rendered as text, held in memory only, for the session.
